```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r libraries, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```


```{r import, echo=FALSE}

suicide_pop = 
read_csv(file = "./data/suicide_pop.csv",
na = c("NA", ".", ""))|>
janitor::clean_names() 

country_code_names = 
read_csv(file = "./data/country_codes",
na = c("NA", ".", ""))|>
janitor::clean_names() 

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
country_total_suicide_mortality = 
suicide_pop |> 
  filter( sex == "Both sexes", cause == "All") |> 
  mutate( suicide_mortality1 = deaths1/new_pop1) |>
  group_by(country, covid)|> 
  summarize(mean_sm1 = mean(suicide_mortality1, na.rm = TRUE) )|> 
  mutate( covid = as.factor(covid))|>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "covid", 
  values_from = "mean_sm1", 
  names_prefix = "covid_") |> 
   mutate( diff_sm1 = (covid_2-covid_1)/covid_1) |> 
  left_join(country_code_names, by ="country") |>
  select(name, everything()) |> 
  mutate(change_increase = diff_sm1 >0 )

total_suicide_mortality = 
  country_total_suicide_mortality|> 
  group_by()|>
  summarize(mean_covid_1 = mean(covid_1, na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean_covid_2 = mean(covid_2, na.rm = TRUE),
            diff_total = (mean_covid_2-mean_covid_1)/mean_covid_1)



```


__Suicide Mortality by Country__

The average suicide mortality for 2017-2019 and 2020-2022 was used to calculate pre and post covid suicide mortality rates. 

diff_sm1 = the percent change difference between pre and post covid suicide mortality,
formula = (Post - Pre)/ Pre

change_increase = flags whether suicide mortality increased or decreased 

```{r,echo=FALSE}
country_total_suicide_mortality |>
  rename(  pre_covid = covid_1 , post_covid = covid_2 )|>
  knitr::kable()

country_total_suicide_mortality |> 
  group_by() |>
  count(change_increase) |>
  knitr::kable()

```

In 36 countries, suicide mortality decreased.
In 28 countries, suicide mortality increased. 
In 17 countries, suicide mortality data was unavailable for either pre or post covid

__Overall Multinational Suicide Mortality__

Average multinational suicide mortality, pre and post covid. 
formula = (Post - Pre)/ Pre

Diff_total indicates overall decrease. 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
total_suicide_mortality |>  
  rename(  mean_pre_covid = mean_covid_1 , mean_post_covid = mean_covid_2 ) |> 
  knitr::kable()
```
